entries.title: Crewmates hear sooner when a check fails
entries.body: A crewmate now hears as soon as the first check fails, so it can look into it while the rest still run. It hears again when they all finish. This covers a pull request's checks and other check runs on GitHub or GitLab that a crewmate starts or follows. The app reads them every minute or two, and the task reads Waiting for checks meanwhile.
entries.noPicture: The change is how soon a crewmate hears about running checks, using the existing Waiting for checks task status without changing its layout.
